83379b6e54bc37b0.summary: Retailers charging extra merchant fees for credit card swipes violates RBI Master Directions and card network rules. Hook: 'Can a shop charge you ₹49 extra just for paying with a credit card? RBI rules say NO.'
83379b6e54bc37b0.notes:
- Social media backlash over retail chain Westside adding a ₹49 fee on credit card payments at checkout.
- RBI circular on Merchant Discount Rate (MDR): banks and card networks (Visa/Mastercard/RuPay) strictly forbid merchants from passing MDR surcharges onto end customers.
- Merchants agree in acquiring bank contracts not to charge convenience fees on credit card transactions at physical Point of Sale (POS) terminals.
- How consumers can report: dispute transaction with card issuing bank for breach of merchant terms and file grievance on RBI CMS portal.
